f6_runtime_fixes.finding: Twelve-location routes wrapped the final locus onto a second row.
f6_runtime_fixes.resolution: Route columns now use the full journey length and remain on one horizontally scrollable row.

f6_runtime_fixes.finding: Late route positions could be off-screen on narrow viewports.
f6_runtime_fixes.resolution: The active route node is automatically centered horizontally without changing vertical reading position.

f6_runtime_fixes.finding: Unit 3 mixed-discrimination sets were exposed by API but blocked by a legacy Unit-2-only scheduling condition.
f6_runtime_fixes.resolution: Mixed-discrimination scheduling is now unit-generic and activates for Unit 3 after all members of a set are encountered.

f6_runtime_fixes.finding: Memory anchors were expanded after every scene, making first exposure feel like a second vocabulary sheet.
f6_runtime_fixes.resolution: Memory anchors remain available but are collapsed by default after the narrative.

f6_runtime_fixes.finding: Listen controls gave no browser feedback and scientific notation could sound awkward in browser speech synthesis.
f6_runtime_fixes.resolution: Listen now reports audio state and normalizes common Unit 3 scientific symbols and abbreviations for speech only.

next_gate: Unit 4 source inventory, scientific atomization, AP scope mapping, conflict audit, and canonical lock before Unit 4 narrative generation.
